the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to

and Medium Enterprises; and

Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have recently
reduced the amount payable to accredited
private hospitals and diagnostic centres in
Delhi for various services/procedures/

SHRI B.J. PANDA:

Forest Credit
*347. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the forest cover is dwindling
in a number of areas in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof during the
last three years, year-wise and State-wise;
(c) the measures proposed to be taken
to ensure sustained growth of forest cover

the tribal people living in the forest areas;

BIS norms for delicate
items
*348. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Bureau of Indian
Standards (BIS) has formulated rules/norms
and fixed standards for the production and
marketing of 109 delicate items used in food
items, etc.;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether these items which are
available in the market meet the rules/
norms/standards fixed by BIS; and

*349. SHRI PRAVEEN RASHTRA-
PAL: Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of new Rail-Road Over
Bridges (ROBs) sanctioned in Gujarat

(b) the status of work on each ROB;
and

Land declared as forest land
*350. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) the percentage of land declared to be
forest land in each State and Union
Territory;
(b) the percentage of forest land not
actually under green-cover;
(c) whether the green-cover is increasing
or decreasing during the last five years; and
(d) whether the forest-dwellers would
be entitled to the land they are occupying
for generation after generation?

†*351. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of  declared forest villages
in the country, State-wise;
(b) the criteria fixed for declaring the
village as a forest village;

have formulated any special scheme for
forest villages; and

Integrated disease surveillance
mechanism
*352. SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether any integrated disease
surveillance mechanism exists in the

(b) if not, the reasons therefor;

mechanism and the protocol followed for a
surveillance under such a mechanism;

any advanced assessment of the recent
outbreak of dengue and chikungunya in
certain parts of the country;

(f) if so, when the earliest projections
were made and what steps were taken by
Government?
Cut in wheat allocation to Orissa
*353. SHRI BHAGIRATHI MAJHI:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government
have reduced the allocation of wheat for
APL consumers under TPDS to Orissa
where the demand for wheat is high due to
increase of price in the open market;

110

provide an ad hoc additional allocation of
wheat to the State;
(c) if so, the quantity that would be
provided in future to meet the urgent
requirement of the State; and

for the same?
Subsidies for wheat production
*354. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a proposal under
Government's consideration to offer liberal
subsidies to the farmers in the country to
substantially increase production of wheat
during the ensuing rabi season; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Share of SSI in export

AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of

to state:
(a) the share of small scale industries in

sector as on date;
(b) the details of contribution of small
scale industries in creating employment
opportunities and property in the country;
(c) whether any long term policy has
been formulated for the development of
small scale industries; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

*356. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government had appointed
any expert committee to study the impact
of new rules on anti-tobacco legislation and
to insist on out-sized logos on cigarette
and bidi packets;
(b) whether Government have recently
received representations from Virginia
Tobacco Growers Associations protesting
against such unilateral orders against
tobacco products;

have not called these associations for
consultations; and
(d) the steps proposed to review the
unilateral decision making process of
Government?

Rs. 1170 crores World Bank assisted
agriculture research programme called the
National Agriculture Innovation Project

technology;
(b) whether Government also plans to
launch a special mission to promote
cultivation of bio-fuel crops like Jatropha,
Karanj crops like sugarcane, kassava, sweet
sorghum, maize, sugarbeats, etc.;

SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 40 per cent
i.e. 16 million hectare paddy producing land,
out of total such land in the country, falls
within the States of Assam, Bihar, M.P.
and Orissa alone;
(b) if not, the facts thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the rate
of production of paddy in these States is
less than the rate of national average
production;
(d) if so, the rates of production in each
of these States;
(e) whether the shortage of foodgrains
in the country can be met by bringing rate
of production in these States at par with
the rate of national production; and
(f) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto?
Coverage of crops under NAIS
*359. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the crops presently covered in
Andhra Pradesh under the National
Agricultural Insurance Scheme (NAIS);
(b) whether the State Government has
sought the intervention of the Central
Government to include certain other
perennial crops in the scheme;
(c) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto and whether Government would
consider to accord sanction for the above
proposals;
(d) the reasons why a farmer
particularly a marginal farmer, usually
hesitates to undertake an insurance cover
under NAIS and what hassles he has to
face; and
(e) the steps the Central Government
would take to help the farmers and make
NAIS more acceptable and farmer
friendly?

Crop loss due to flood
†2569. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that heavy damage
has been caused to agriculture crops by
recent flood in some States of the country
particularly Maharashtra, Gujarat,
Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh and Madhya
Pradesh;
(b) whether any survey by the Centre
has been conducted to access the damage
caused by the flood;
(c) if so, the details of the damage caused
by the flood, State-wise;
(d) whether Government have extended
any help to the States keeping in view the
damage caused to agriculture; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Shortage of fishes in the oceans
2570. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
an acute shortage of fishes is on the increase
in the oceans, these days;
(b) if so, whether it is a fact that as a
result of fish catching, there shall be no fish
in the oceans at the end of 2050AD; and
(c) if so, the steps being taken/proposed
to be taken by Government particularly in
the Bay of Bengal, Arabian Sea and Indian
Ocean not to allow catching of fishes to
avoid scarcity of food etc., in future?
G. M. crops
†2571. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the genetically
modified seeds of a number of crops are
being used for production in the country;
(b) if so, the names of these seeds and
the developers of these seeds;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the

588
advantages of these seeds are being
highlighted by the developers of the seeds
while their negative effects are being
concealed; and
(d) if so, Government's reaction thereto?
Status of Central Agriculture
University Imphal
2572. SHRI RISHANG KEISHING:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the present status and condition of
the Central Agriculture University, Imphal,
Manipur;
(b) the number of colleges affiliated to
this university; and
(c) the steps taken by the Centre to
develop the university?
Promoting Bio-fertilizers
†2573. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a serious
crisis has cropped up for human health and
environment, etc., in the country due to
chemicals based agriculture and depleting
land fertility;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
Government have taken a decision to
introduce bio-farming as an alternative to
discourage chemicals based agriculture and
to encourage bio-farming vigorously;
(c) whether Government have decided
to adopt a strategy of making the process
of certification of bio-products easy, cheap
and easily available; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Share of agriculture
2574. DR. K. MALAISAMY:
 SHRI C. PERUMAL:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the share of
agriculture has declined to 19.9 per cent of
GDP during 2005-06;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and the
steps envisaged to enhance it;
(c) whether there would be a special
thrust and top priority ensured to go for
large area of sugarcane production and its
productivity particularly in the wake of
tremendous potentiality for sugar export;
and
(d) the details of States producing sugar
and the quantity produced during the last
three years and the corresponding export
market available during that period?

Horticulture Mission
2575. PROF. P. J. KURIEN: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether coconut is also included in
the National Horticulture Mission;
(b) if not, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government have received
any representation to include it in the
Mission; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto?
Encouraging the use of low nutrient
analysis fertilizers
2576. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:

encourage use of low nutrient analysis
fertilizer products such as NP 16:20, NP
20:20, Ammonium Sulphate, etc.; and
(b) the details of steps being taken to
supplement identified deficiencies of
sulphur and zinc in the soil especially in
South India?
Shortage of milk at Mother Dairy
booths
†2577. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that supply of
milk to consumers has reduced due to
shortage of milk at Mother Dairy booths
in Delhi caused by occurance of flood in
Gujarat;
(b) if so, the percentage of shortage of
milk; and
(c) the steps taken to meet the shortage?
Diversion of agricultural land for
non-agricultural purposes
2578. SHRIMATI S. G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that suggestions
have been received to conserve prime
farmland for agriculture and that it should
not be diverted for non-agricultural
purposes;
(b) if so, the steps being taken by
Government in this regard;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
Government have received suggestions to
amend the Constitution to bring agriculture
in the Concurrent List; and
(d) if so, the steps being taken by
Government in this regard?
Damage to cotton crops due
to pests
2579. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that cotton, an important
commercial crop grown in India, is being
attacked by a number of pests in various
States resulting into damage of cotton
crops; and
(b) if so, the details of measures
proposed by Government to save the
cotton crop from the pest attack, to save
the poor agriculturists?

sugarcane
2580. SHRI SHARAD
ANANTRAO JOSHI:
SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether any study has been made
to assess the cost of production of
sugarcane in the country;
(b) if so, the results thereof, State-wise;
(c) the details of average cost of
production of sugarcane in the country
during the years 2002-03, 2003-04,
2004-05 and 2005-06, State-wise; and
(d) the names of States which had the
maximum and minimum cost of production
of sugarcane during the above-mentioned
period,  year-wise?

Adulteration of fertilizers, insecticides
and chemicals
2581. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
complaints regarding adulteration in
fertilizers, insecticides and chemicals due
to which production is declining every year;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the steps taken by Government to
prevent this malpractice;
(d) whether any report has been
received regarding adulteration of fertilizers
from Andhra Pradesh during the last two
years; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Cattle based integrated farming
system
2582. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
cattle-based Integrated Farming System
(IFS) is ideal for small and medium farmers;
(b) whether Government are also aware
that it is not only eco-friendly but also
economical for farmers to raise animals since
animals help in efficient recycling of organic
crop residues;
(c) how far it is a fact that the manure
gas can be derived by using locally available
cattle waste and other organic wastes;
(d) if so, whether Government are taking
steps to promote IFS in the country for
small and medium farmers; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Cultivation of vegetables
2583. SHRI VIJAYKUMAR RUPANI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that consumption
of vegetables is only 170 grams against an
ideal requirement of 285 grams per day per
capita in our country;
(b) how much agricultural land is used
to grow vegetables and how much more
land should be brought under cultivation
for vegetables;
(c) whether it is also a fact that instead
of 5 to 6 lakh hectares of land, only 1.90
lakh hectares of land is used for vegetable
cultivation in Gujarat; and
(d) the steps taken to increase vegetable
production in Gujarat?

Pradesh
†2584. SHRI DILIP SINGH JUDEV:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of farmers who had to
commit suicide in Andhra Pradesh and
Maharashtra owing to damage of crops,
indebtness and drought, etc. during the last
three years particularly from April, 2006
to October, 2006;
(b) the details of the assistance provided
by Government to the families of the
deceased farmers;
(c) the names of the deceased farmers
out of them who had the crop insurance
and other insurance;
(d) the details of the measures adopted
to ensure that this kind of tragedy is not
repeated in future; and

(e) the details of grants released by the
Centre as well as State Governments
alongwith the details of expenditure thereof
till October, 2006?
Availability of agricultural land

Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is less availability of
new land for agricultural purpose in the
country whereas population of farmer
community is rising continuously;
(b) whether agricultural land is being
acquired on a large scale throughout the
country each year for non-agricultural
purposes;
(c) if so, the action being taken to
provide agricultural land to farmers after
creation of new land to meet such shortage
of land; and
(d) the details of agricultural land
acquired for non-agricultural purposes
during the last five years, State-wise?
Setting up of National Rain-fed Area
Authority
2586. SHRI B. J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to set
up National Rain-fed Area Authority to
look into ways to improve agriculture
productivity in regions dependent on
rainfall;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what is the action of Government to
improve the productivity of rain-fed regions
of Orissa under the  above project?
Cultivation of sugarcane in Brazil
†2587. SHRIMATI SUSHMA
SWARAJ: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India has
formulated a plan to grow sugarcane in
Brazil;
(b) whether it is also a fact that there is
a proposal to take one lakh hectares of land
on lease for implementation of this plan;
and
(c) if so, the justification for this plan
and whether it won't be prejudicial to the
farmers of the country?
Grameen Bhandaran Yojana
2588. SHRI SUDARSHAN
AKARAPU: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have launched
a new scheme "Grameen Bhandaran Yojana"
to create storage capacity in rural areas;
(b) if so, the number of godowns set up
under the scheme in the rural areas as on
31st October, 2006, State-wise;
(c) the total storage capacity created,
so far, under the scheme; and
(d) the total amount sanctioned and
spent under the scheme?
Agriculture Relief Commission in
Maharashtra
†2589. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that constitution
of an Agriculture Relief Commission in
Maharashtra has been suggested in view of
suicides being committed by the farmers in

Maharashtra so that immediate relief can
be provided to farmers in crisis;
(b) if so, the decision taken in this regard;
(c) whether any provision has been
made to extend immediate economic relief
to farmers on failure or damage of their
crops so that farmers are not forced to
commit suicide; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

2590. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the total area of land proposed to be
brought under micro-irrigation in Rajasthan
during the Tenth Five Year plan;
(b) the total area of land brought under
the scheme in the State, so far;
(c) whether Government would increase
the financial assistance from the present
50 percent to 75 per cent cost of the material
as Rajasthan is a poor desert State; and
(d) how much aid has, so far, been
provided by the Centre?
Survey for paying remunerative price
to farmers
†2591. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that farmers are
not getting price of their production vis-a-
vis increasing prices of implements,
fertilizers and seeds used for agricultural
production;
(b) whether Government would
conduct a survey in this regard; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?

Area Authority

the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
constituted a National Rain-fed Area
Authority as announced by the hon'ble
Prime Minister in his Independence Day
speech in 2005;
(b) if so, the details thereof including its
mandate and time-frame for
accomplishment of specific tasks targeted,
if any, for the authority; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Business ventures of NAFED
2593. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of non-agricultural
business ventures indulged and invested in
by the National Agricultural Co-operative
Marketing Federation (NAFED) since
during the last three years till October 31,
2006, showing items traded/projects
pursued in volume, value as well as
